step.cmd: Refer to Extension of the benefit period before proceeding to step 24.
In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 35 - You received an arbitration award .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the correct BPC.
Work item: Select 91 - Overpayment .
Work type: Select 8 - Grievance settlement .

Remarks line 1: Type “Grievance settlement - EIA [45 or 46] - [name of employer]. M175 C, E, S or V- $[XXXX] (amount to allocate) from [XXXX] (first day of allocation) to [XXXX] (last day of allocation), $[XXXX] (amount to be allocated on last week if different).”

Remarks line 2 (to be used if top-up amount is to be input): Type “M175 C, E, S or V- $[XXXX] (amount to allocate) from [XXXX] (first day of allocation) to [XXXX] (last day of allocation), $[XXXX] (amount to be allocated on last week if different)”.

Remarks line 3: Enter the information about the BP extension if necessary. If the grievance settlement falls under EIA 46, instruct the IPOC officer to create a REM WI to inform the processing officer once the OP is created.
Remarks line 4: Send REM WI TO DEC MAKER FOR ACS LETTERS.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .
Go to ACS letters . ACS letters

step.cmd: Determine if the client has received the monies.

ul.li: If yes go to ACS letters . ACS letters
If no, wait for the REM-WI from IPOC before going to ACS letters . ACS letters

step.cmd: Move the WI to Pending until the IPOC officer sends a REM WI indicating that the work is completed.
When the REM WI is received, in PSCD, input a 1 -Administrative lock on the account. Refer to Applying, modifying or terminating a lock in PSCD and return to this task.
Create a Note in PSCD. Go to Creating a Note in PSCD for a wrongful dismissal or grievance settlement under EIA 46 and return to this task.
